text:
The pilot shows where support is going. We tested the new help page with 12 customers. Nine found the refund policy on their own and three needed a link from a staff member. We didn't measure how long the task took. The next test starts November 4 and keeps the same wording with a larger Refunds button.

You can't say for sure that the button size will change the results. That's the whole point of running the second round. If the nine who found the policy on their own keep doing so with the bigger button you'll have something to build on. For now the only thing you know is what those twelve people did.
